meta.bt: Tested out of sample (2021 to 2026, each season judged only on trends from the seasons before it): every side with a spot covering 5+ points above what its closing price implied (55%+ at -110) on 50+ games went 527-486 (52.0%, -0.7% return) against the closing line; 8+ points (58%+) on 100+ games, 144-126 (53.3%, +1.8% return); the first line alone, 379-307 (55.2%, +5.7% return). Totals the same way: 273-263 (50.9%, -2.8% return). Graded at each game's closing price: mixed, near break-even and mostly inside normal luck. Context, not a pick.
meta.bt_short: Out of sample (2021 to 2026, trends from earlier seasons only): sides whose spot ran 55%+ (5+ points over the price) on 50+ games went 527-486 (52.0%, -0.7% return), about break-even, inside normal luck.
meta.bt_held: Of 46 spots the rule bet, 1 made money at closing prices in 3+ later seasons with p < .05, and 1 still clears that bar after correcting for how many spots were tried: Road dogs of 3.5-7 77-40 (+25.4%).
